title: SSL And Certificates
summary: SSL is enabled with server keys and ssl = on, verified by ssl_is_used or client connection metadata, and enforced with hostssl rules. Client certificate authentication can bind identity to certificates, but it needs certificate lifecycle, revocation posture, and hostname verification such as verify-full.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of SSL And Certificates.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
